name: Laborer 1
summary: Laborer 1 is GLroad's full-size bipedal humanoid developed for labor-intensive tasks, including inspection of power substations. The manufacturer shows the robot in a substation inspection setting. Its visible hardware includes two articulated arms, exposed joint mechanisms, and a sensor-equipped head. It is a demonstrated development platform; the captured pages do not establish general commercial availability.
